questions.stem: Why are microwaves used for satellite communications rather than radio waves?

options.text: Microwaves travel faster than radio waves
Radio waves cannot travel through space
Microwaves can pass through the Earth's atmosphere with less absorption and can be focused into narrow beams

questions.explanation: Microwaves are used for satellite communication because they can pass through the atmosphere with relatively little absorption and can be focused into narrow beams using dish aerials. This allows efficient, targeted communication with satellites. All EM waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
